title: MalAvi Lineage History record
description: One event that changed what a lineage name means: its sequence replaced, the name changed, the lineage merged into another, or removed. Added to the release on 2026-09-25 by the curators' decision of 2026-09-24; 10 columns.

LINEAGE_NAME.description: The name the event is filed under: the surviving name, or for a removal the name removed.

NEW_NAME.description: The name after the event; the same as OLD_NAME for a sequence update; empty for a removal.

OLD_SEQUENCE.description: The sequence stored before the event; empty when it was not recorded (events before the table existed).

NEW_SEQUENCE.description: The sequence stored after the event; empty for a removal.

DATE.description: ISO date of the decision; empty when not recorded.

SOURCE.description: Submission id, GenBank accession, person, or 'curator decision'.

RELEASE.description: The release in which the change first appears.
